shortDescription: Insert data from a file into an SQLite database table.

options.name: alter
options.description: If set, missing columns will be added automatically.

options.name: analyze
options.description: Analyze the table after inserting data.

options.name: batch_size
options.description: Batch size for bulk inserts.

options.name: convert
options.description: Dictionary specifying SQL conversion functions to apply to data during insertion.

options.name: db_path
options.description: Path to the SQLite database.

options.name: empty_null
options.description: Convert empty strings to NULL.

options.name: file_path
options.description: Path to the file containing the data to insert.

options.name: flatten
options.description: Flatten nested structures in JSON/CSV into individual rows.

options.name: ignore
options.description: If a record with the same primary key already exists, the insertion will be ignored.

options.name: imports
options.description: Python modules to import when using --convert.

options.name: lines
options.description: Indicates if the JSON file has one record per line.

options.name: nl
options.description: Specifies if the file uses newlines as a delimiter.

options.name: not_null
options.description: Specifies columns that should be NOT NULL.

options.name: pk
options.description: Specifies which column should be the primary key when creating the table.

options.name: replace
options.description: If a record with the same primary key already exists, it will be replaced.

options.name: silent
options.description: Do not show progress bar or any other output.

options.name: stop_after
options.description: Stop after inserting this many rows.

options.name: table
options.description: Name of the table to insert data into.

options.name: text
options.description: Treat all values in CSV/TSV as text.

options.name: truncate
options.description: If set, the table will be truncated before inserting the new data.

options.name: upsert
options.description: If set, the existing rows will be updated.
